title: Scalar Quantizer Encoder
text: Encode each input value by associating it with index value of quantization region, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Source of quantizer parameters}, {Partitioning}, {Boundary points}, {Searching method}, {Tie-breaking rule} sets the action when input value is same as boundary point Choose the lower, {Output codeword}, {Output quantization error}, {Codebook} sets the quantized output values, {Output clipping status}, {Action for out of range input}, {Index output data type} and {Saturate on integer overflow}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source of quantizer parameters
params.values: Source of quantizer parameters Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Tie-breaking rule
params.values: Action when input value is same as boundary point Choose the lower index (default) | Choose the higher index

params.name: Action for out of range input
params.values: Action for out of range input Clip | Clip and warn | Error

params.name: Index output data type
params.values: Index output data type int32 (default) | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on
